parts.t: Sumas Prairie is about 90 sq km of low-lying, productive farmland in east Abbotsford, on the former Sumas Lake bottom. It flooded in November 2021 and again in December 2025, so flood protection is the first thing to understand before you buy here.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 10, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate since 2015. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Abbotsford and the Agricultural Land Commission.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.
